capabilities: show relative line numbers in the editor
extras: Requires enabling the built-in "Show line number" setting in Editor options; the README does not document setup beyond this note.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin enables relative line numbers (similar to Vim's relativenumber) in editor mode.
problem: Obsidian's editor only shows absolute line numbers, so users who navigate by relative distances (a Vim habit) have no built-in option.

relations.evidence: relative line numbers (similar to Vim's relativenumber)

summary: Editor enhancement that displays Vim-style relative line numbers in Obsidian's editor mode.
